judged.what: The creator says 'sign me out' as opponents get fancy, only to get brutally bumped out of his goal and scored on, yelling 'Savage man! Savage! Brutal!'
judged.reason: He complains about fancy players right before getting hilariously bumped out of the play for an opponent goal. His laughing, amazed reaction to getting wrecked gives the moment a great comedic payoff.
